messages:
ana_fin: hey @mike_billing — I just pulled the invoice for Greenfield Health (private deployment renewal) and there's a platform fee line plus a full-support-tier charge even though they upgraded mid-term. can someone confirm proration rules? :thinking:

mike_billing: sending the invoice now. which contract/id? I can look up the change event in Zuora.

ana_fin: contract is RF-2024-GFH-009, amendment #3. upgrade executed 2026-10-14 per sam's note. invoice: INV-2026-1107-784 (PDF link below).

billing-bot: Invoice INV-2026-1107-784 generated for RF-2024-GFH-009 — $74,200. PDF: https://invoices.internal/redwood/INV-2026-1107-784.pdf

sam_csm: fwiw, customer requested support upgrade (Standard -> Premium) on 2026-10-14 and asked for proration to next invoice. they were told account team would handle credits.

kate_sales: the amendment we signed has this clause: "support-tier changes will be prorated unless explicitly waived by finance" — I flagged it to legal but didn't see a waiver.

mike_billing: ok pulling the billing events... looks like the platform fee is annual and was re-invoiced at renewal date (2026-11-01). support tier charge for Premium was billed as full month on 2026-11-07, so that looks like system treated the change as end-of-month effective rather than mid-cycle.

ana_fin: here's the invoice snippet I copied from the PDF:

```
1 x Private Deployment License (RF-2024-GFH-009) — $60,000.00
Platform Fee (annual) — $10,000.00
Support - Premium (monthly) — $4,200.00
Tax — $0.00
Total — $74,200.00
Note: Support tier applied as of 2026-11-01
```

kate_sales: that "applied as of" is the problem — customer expects Premium from 2026-10-14 -> should be pro-rated for 17 days in Oct and then full Nov if billing cadence is monthly.

mike_billing: Zuora event log shows amendment effective_date=2026-10-14 but billing_effective_date=2026-11-01. suggests the amendment was set to take effect at next billing cycle. we can either issue a one-off credit for the prorated delta or reissue a corrected invoice (less desirable). what's finance preference?

eric_fpna: prefer to issue a credit memo to keep accounting clean. if the amount is < $10k we can auto-approve; otherwise we need Sophie to sign off. please estimate the prorated delta.

ana_fin: rough calc: Premium monthly $4,200 vs Standard $2,100 -> delta $2,100/month. prorate 17/31 days in Oct = $1,150 (approx). So credit ~ $1.15k against INV-2026-1107-784 and adjust next invoice.

mike_billing: can confirm with exact proration calc. will run the billing engine job and attach the credit memo draft. will hold doing final post until @sophie_finance approves if > $10k.

sophie_finance: quick Q — is the platform fee dispute part of this or only support proration?

ana_fin: only support proration. customer doesn't dispute platform fee; they just flagged the support line.

sophie_finance: OK. since this is < $10k and is customer-facing (we messed up expectation), approve issuing a credit memo for the prorated amount and note it on the account. please add a short rationale: "prorated credit due to support tier effective date mismatch (customer requested 2026-10-14)."

mike_billing: Roger. I'll produce CreditMemo-CM-2026-1110-342 for ~$1,150 and apply to invoice INV-2026-1107-784. posting in ~30m.

billing-bot: Credit Memo CM-2026-1110-342 created and applied to INV-2026-1107-784. PDF: https://invoices.internal/redwood/CM-2026-1110-342.pdf

sam_csm: I'll message the customer to confirm they see the credit and update their portal. thanks team :thumbsup:

ana_fin: thanks all. can we add a quick billing checklist item to the amendment flow so support-tier changes default to "immediate" effective_date in billing to avoid this? cc @kate_sales to follow up with product/billing integration.

kate_sales: yup i'll put a ticket in our backlog and loop legal if we need contract language tweaks.

eric_fpna: closing note: record the credit in this month's revenue adjustments journal with label "support proration - GFH". I'll own the entry.

sophie_finance: thanks — good quick resolution."
